mapper.select: SELECT TOP (200) SEQNO AS msgid, BIZTYPE AS messagetype, MSG AS msg, MSG AS msg_sms, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, CALLPHONE AS phn, REQPHONE AS smssender, REQTIME AS reservedt, FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS regdt, YELLOWID_KEY AS profile, TEMPLATECODE AS tmplid, BTN_02_URL_01 AS button1 FROM ${msg_table} WHERE RESULT = '0' AND KIND = #{msg_type} AND ( REQTIME IS NULL OR REQTIME = '00000000000000' OR REQTIME <= FORMAT(GETDATE(), 'yyyyMMddHHmmss') ) ORDER BY SEQNO ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = SCHEMA_NAME() AND TABLE_NAME = #{logTable}
mapper.update: SELECT * INTO ${logTable} FROM ( SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2 ) AS T
